#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stack>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;

    int res = 0;
    std::stack<char> currentRun;

    for (char ch : str) {
        if (currentRun.empty() || currentRun.top() == ch) {
            currentRun.push(ch);
        } else {
            if (currentRun.size() % 2 == 0) {
                res++;
            }
            while (!currentRun.empty()) {
                currentRun.pop();
            }
            currentRun.push(ch);
        }
    }

    if (currentRun.size() % 2 == 0) {
        res++;
    }

    std::cout << res << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
